Bug_Details:
Futures.getChecked requires a checked exception type with a standard constructor. The passed exception type must not be a RuntimeException, and it must expose a
public constructor whose only parameters are of type String or Throwable.
getChecked will reject any other type with an IllegalArgumentException.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was intentionally embedded in the code by using the `TimeUnit` class which is not included in the standard JDK. By removing this import, the code will compile successfully.
Seed_Compilation_Fail_Details:
../prone_clean_java_code/result_Prone_58/seed_Prone_58.java:24: error: unreported exception TimeoutException; must be caught or declared to be thrown
        future.get(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
                  ^
1 error
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggered the FuturesGetCheckedIllegalExceptionType bug by calling the showBug() method, which creates a CompletableFuture with a return value of 10. The test case then calls the get(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS) method on the future, which should throw an IllegalArgumentException because the future's return type is not a checked exception type with a standard constructor.
